summary.text: Neal Foster, a Democrat from Nome, has represented District 39 in the Alaska House of Representatives since taking the oath of office on November 16, 2009.

paragraphs.text: The legislative biography says Foster was born in Nome on May 29, 1972, and holds a B.A. in political science from Stanford University (1996) and a business degree in finance from the University of Alaska (1997).
Foster served on the Nome City Council from 2008 to 2009, and the biography lists Foster as owner of Foster Properties and as a real estate investor.
